issues.message: -march=native compiles for AVX-512 or for the build host (-march=native), but preempt nodes have AVX2 only: the program can die with 'Illegal instruction'. Use -march=x86-64-v3, or run on a partition whose nodes have AVX-512

data.note: Static check only; nothing was submitted. preempt gives whole nodes, so cost is per node regardless of cores used.
